title: camtrapEvents: Metadata-Aware Independence Filtering for Camera-Trap Data
description: An R package for classifying repeated camera-trap records into detection events. Alongside a conventional time threshold, observable metadata such as group size, age and sex counts, behaviour or identity labels can contribute evidence for a new event. Conservative running-maximum and optional two-time-scale rules limit repeated splitting, while sensitivity summaries make the consequences of analytical choices explicit.
